review_description: Paul was terrific throughout - from quote to finish.We are in a village and were limited to a 2.5Kw system with no feed back to the grid as it is embedded supply.Even though it was a small job he gave it priority and his suggestion of excess solar power going to heat the hws was the icing.Friendly, thorough installers who explained everything as the job progressed.
Great company to deal with. Office staff and the installers in the field are hardworking, polite, professional and tidy.Terrific response to any queries.

Quoting was indicative then proper quote after site visit. Installer happy to discuss any aspect of the installation. The installation went according to the design/quote and we had a couple of other electrical jobs carried out at the same time. Cost here includes Green Catch Power and 2 Tigos. All work looks high quality. Just waiting on the new meter now - which the installer was happy to put in the request for as well.

I spent the month of July 2017 researching efficiency of Solar Power products and the integrity of manufacturers. I looked at many and varied websites. I chose a local supplier who could supply me with my preferred system and also because I am passionate about our small local community and supporting local businesses. I have chosen Suntech 295W panels and Enphase Micro Inverters. I intend to have the racking tilted to 30 degrees to optimise the early morning sun in winter. I intend having 6 of our 16 panels facing due east as we have an ocean view to maximise early morning light. The remaining 10 panels will face due north.

Solar quotes gave invaluable and useful advice which assisted with the decision making. I did a lot of research. I got several quotes.Lakeside actually came to the house, looked at the roof and access, explained where the envoy could be located.Some other providers quoted for single storey, metal roof even though I had told them/ completed a form stating that it was 2 storey, tile roof. When challenged they requoted much higher. A neighbour warned me this would happen, that a quote would get much larger once they arrived to instal and forms were signed, so it is necessary to read the quotes carefully.Another supplier said I could not have a battery because they aren't available. They are but that company did not have the ability to do it and did not want to tell me that
Lady in office has excellent knowledge, she is polite and very helpful . Installation was very good and very professional, system is  working perfectly . I will not hesitate recommend them.
